review.title: Leopard-print top · neckline moves toward GT
review.finding: The previous neckline sits too low. After tuning it rises noticeably toward the GT neckline, reducing the excess exposed chest.
review.before: The neckline is too low, exposing too much chest.
review.gt: A higher neckline covers more of the upper chest.
review.after: The neckline rises toward the GT position.
review.verdict: A visible structural improvement, but not a complete fix.
review.remaining: The neckline is still below GT, and the print arrangement is still different.
review.metric: Predefined neckline window: MAE 34.79 → 21.67 (37.7% lower); SSIM 0.481 → 0.527.
review.point_note: Fresh Molmo points at the lower print before and the torso after, not this neckline. This improvement was found by visual review.

review.title: Black sheer top · extra chest line removed
review.finding: The extra horizontal dark line in the previous generation is absent from GT and no longer visibly crosses the chest after tuning.
review.before: An extra line bridges the sheer chest between the lace panels.
review.gt: The chest is sheer here, with no horizontal bridge.
review.after: The spurious horizontal bridge is removed.
review.verdict: That specific extra line is fixed locally.
review.remaining: The surrounding lace motifs still differ from GT. This is a training example, not evidence of a general fix.
review.point_note: Its after point lands on the jeans, not on this chest detail. The fix verdict comes from comparing these pixels with GT.

review.title: Black button top · buttons look less hollow
review.finding: The lower buttons become brighter and less ring-like, moving toward the solid light buttons in GT. The change is modest, not a reconstruction of the placket.
review.before: Dark, hollow-looking rings at the button positions.
review.after: The lower buttons have lighter, more filled centers.
review.remaining: Button position, spacing and precise shape still do not match GT.
review.metric: Predefined lower-button window: MAE 10.58 → 9.61 (9.1% lower); SSIM 0.776 → 0.784.
review.point_note: Molmo marks all four button positions both before and after; the visual gain does not amount to a full fix.
